question: Does training-only z-score standardization change fixed 5-NN classification accuracy on UCI Wine cultivar labels?
status: protocol recorded before this case first evaluation; not registered; familiar public benchmark

split.method: within each sorted class, random.Random(seed).shuffle sequentially; first ceil(0.25*n_class) test; remaining train; sort row IDs

selection: no tuning or condition selection from test results; all 6 seeds and 3 conditions reported

metrics.primary_contrast: zscore_train_5nn minus raw_5nn in percentage points

interval.population: primary split test observations conditional on fitted training models and fixed empirical class proportions
interval.supplementary: descriptive only; shared observations across splits; no pooled inference

failure_policy: retain negative or null results; do not change protocol after seeing outcomes; archive amendments if required
budget: CPU, no paid service, core standard library, optional existing plotting environment
